Source.evidence_source: [/page/11/Text/4] However, for the parent variables, significant Time [Wilk's Lambda = .643, F(8,94) = 2.91, p < .01] and Group × Time interaction effects [Wilk's Lambda = .716, F(8,94) = 2.13, p < .05] were achieved. Univariate analyses of the interactions showed significant effects for all three CBCL variables, Internalizing [F(2,50) = 3.56, p < .05], Externalizing [F(2,50) = 3.70, p < .05], and Depression [F(2,50) = 6.48, p < .01].
